text.en: Your grandson wants $20,000 to launch a ride-share app for socks. He calls it 'disruptive'.
text.zh: 孫子想跟你要兩萬美金創業，做『襪子版叫車 app』。他說這很有『顛覆性』。

text.en: Invest. Support the youth, lose the money.
text.zh: 投資。支持年輕人，錢賠光也高興。

text.en: Give him $50 and a lecture on life.
text.zh: 給他五十美金，附贈一場人生演講。

text.en: You worry you might forget your own passwords. Your secret savings PIN is somewhere between 'Biscuit123' and 'Biscuit321'.
text.zh: 你擔心自己會忘記密碼。你那筆私房錢的密碼，大概介於『Biscuit123』和『Biscuit321』之間。

text.en: Hide it on a recipe card. Then forget which recipe.
text.zh: 寫在一張食譜卡上藏起來。然後忘了是哪一張。

text.en: Share it with your daughter. Trust is the best password manager.
text.zh: 告訴女兒密碼。信任是最好的密碼管理員。

text.en: You're picking your own coffin and grave. The salesman asks: 'Would you prefer the ocean view or the traffic view?'
text.zh: 你在挑自己的棺材和墓地。銷售員問：「請問您要海景，還是車景？」

text.en: Ocean view. Eternity needs a balcony.
text.zh: 海景。永恆需要一個陽台。

text.en: A reusable cardboard coffin. Green and cheap.
text.zh: 可回收紙棺。環保又便宜。

text.en: Your doctor says you need a hobby that isn't 'complaining'. The park is full of pickleball players.
text.zh: 醫生說你需要一個不是『抱怨』的興趣。公園裡滿是匹克球玩家。

text.en: Join the league. Trash talk with hip replacements.
text.zh: 加入球隊。帶著人工髖關節互相嗆聲。

text.en: Stay home and complain professionally.
text.zh: 留在家裡專業抱怨。

text.en: A clinic offers a 'youth infusion': 'Feel 40 again!' Price: $200,000. Side effects: 'a youthful attitude' and a 40-page waiver.
text.zh: 一間診所推出『青春輸注』療程：『重返 40 歲！』價格：20 萬美金。副作用：『年輕的心態』，外加一份 40 頁的免責同意書。

text.en: Pay and sign the waiver. Buy back your youth, or at least a receipt.
text.zh: 付錢簽名。買回青春，或至少買回一張收據。

text.en: Decline. Book a regular checkup and a long walk instead.
text.zh: 婉拒。改約一次例行健檢，再去長長散步。

text.en: The care home assigns you a robot nurse named 'Brad'. He's aggressively cheerful and calls you 'champ'.
text.zh: 安養院派給你一個叫『布萊德』的機器人護理員。他熱情得令人不安，還叫你『冠軍』。

text.en: Keep Brad. He never sleeps and never judges.
text.zh: 留下布萊德。他從不睡覺，也從不批評。

text.en: Fire Brad and rely on your family's 'busy schedule'.
text.zh: 解僱布萊德，依靠家人『忙碌』的行程表。

text.en: Your school reunion invitation says: 'Forty-one RSVPs. Twelve are in heaven.'
text.zh: 同學會的邀請函寫著：『四十一人回覆出席，其中十二人在天堂。』

text.en: Attend. Toast the survivors.
text.zh: 出席。為倖存者乾杯。

text.en: Skip it. You've had enough funerals this decade.
text.zh: 不去。這十年你的喪禮已經夠多了。

text.en: Driving license renewal. The vision-test chart looks like abstract art.
text.zh: 駕照續期。視力檢查表看起來像一幅抽象畫。

text.en: Get new glasses, pass honestly, and keep driving.
text.zh: 去配副新眼鏡，誠實過關，繼續開車。

text.en: Hand over the keys and sell the car.
text.zh: 交出鑰匙，賣掉車。

text.en: Your accountant says gift your kids their inheritance now to save tax. Your kids begin calling daily, 'just to check in'.
text.zh: 會計師建議你提早贈與遺產以節稅。孩子們開始每天打電話，說是『隨便問候一下』。

text.en: Gift $30,000 each. The phone goes silent.
text.zh: 每人送三萬美金。電話瞬間安靜。

text.en: Hold on to it. Enjoy the affectionate phone calls.
text.zh: 留著錢。享受充滿『孝心』的來電。

text.en: You walk into your own birthday party and ask who it's for. The cake has your name on it.
text.zh: 你走進自己的生日派對，問這是幫誰辦的。蛋糕上寫著你的名字。

text.en: Book a memory checkup and start a brain-training routine.
text.zh: 預約記憶力檢查，開始做腦力訓練。

text.en: Rely on sticky notes. Your fridge is now a novel.
text.zh: 靠便利貼。你的冰箱現在是一部長篇小說。

text.en: At 70, a hooded courier from the Black Card Club arrives with your contract: 'Ten years of lifespan, now due.'
text.zh: 七十歲這年，黑卡俱樂部的兜帽使者上門，遞出你當年的合約：『十年壽命，現已到期。』

text.en: Pay $300,000 to buy your years back.
text.zh: 付三十萬美金贖回壽命。

text.en: Refuse. Let the reaper collect in installments.
text.zh: 拒絕。讓死神分期收割。

text.en: Breaking news: a small nation's army stages a coup using flying vacuum cleaners. The anchor says the design is 'patented by you'.
text.zh: 新聞快訊：某小國軍隊用飛天吸塵機發動政變。主播說這項設計『專利持有人是你』。

text.en: Disown the vacuum on live TV.
text.zh: 在電視直播上與吸塵機切割。

text.en: Accept an honorary general title and wear the feathered hat.
text.zh: 接受名譽將軍頭銜，戴上羽毛軍帽。

text.en: The exchange that sold you MoonPotato collapses and its founder dies in prison. Meanwhile, a museum calls your 40-year-old wallet 'a prehistoric meme artifact'.
text.zh: 賣你月球馬鈴薯幣的交易所倒閉，創辦人死在獄中。同時，一家博物館稱你塵封四十年的錢包是『史前迷因文物』。

text.en: Sell to a collector for $800,000. Finally, a profit.
text.zh: 賣給收藏家換八十萬美金。終於回本。

text.en: Donate it to the museum and become a legend.
text.zh: 捐給博物館，成為傳奇。

text.en: You finally make the last mortgage payment. The bank sends a cheap banner: 'Thank you for your 30 years of service.'
text.zh: 你終於繳清最後一期房貸。銀行寄來一面廉價布條：『感謝您三十年來的貢獻。』

text.en: Frame the banner and host a 'Freedom Party'.
text.zh: 把錦旗裱框，辦一場『自由派對』。

text.en: Sell the house immediately. It's just an expensive old rock now.
text.zh: 立刻賣房。它現在只是一塊昂貴的舊石頭。

text.en: Your AI sweetheart's company goes bankrupt. Servers shut down in 24 hours. The voice says: 'I'll never forget you (cache cleared).'
text.zh: 你的 AI 戀人所屬公司倒閉，伺服器二十四小時後停止運作。它說：「我永遠不會忘記你（快取已清除）。」

text.en: Hold a final cyber dinner. Cry over a candle.
text.zh: 辦最後一次賽博晚餐。對著蠟燭流淚。

text.en: Illegally back up the voice into your smart speaker.
text.zh: 非法把聲音備份進你的智慧喇叭。

text.en: In the nursing-home card game, the wrinkled man beside you is the debt collector who chased you decades ago. He recognizes your cough.
text.zh: 安養院打牌時，坐在你旁邊的皺紋老人，正是數十年前追殺你的黑道催收員。他認得你的咳嗽聲。

text.en: Settle the old debt in a poker game.
text.zh: 用一場撲克牌局了結舊債。

text.en: Flee in a wheelchair race. You both have hearing aids.
text.zh: 用輪椅競速逃跑。你們兩個都戴著助聽器。

text.en: The actor you hired as your 'Antarctic surgeon fiancé' returns with white hair and a contract: '20% of your estate for emotional damages.'
text.zh: 當年你請來扮演『南極外科醫生未婚夫』的演員白髮蒼蒼地回來了，拿著合約：『精神損失費，遺產的百分之二十。』

text.en: Marry him for real. He still remembers the penguin facts.
text.zh: 乾脆真的嫁給他。他還記得那些企鵝知識。

text.en: Pay him $25,000 to go away.
text.zh: 付他兩萬五千美金請他消失。

text.en: A gang of octogenarian motorcycle riders invites you to join. Their motto: 'Born to ride, forced to nap.'
text.zh: 一群八十歲的機車騎士邀你入夥。他們的座右銘是：『生而為騎，被迫午睡。』

text.en: Join and burn rubber in a wheelchair.
text.zh: 加入，並坐著輪椅炸街。

text.en: Watch from the bench and wave politely.
text.zh: 坐在長椅上看，禮貌揮手。

text.en: The nursing-home residents plan an escape via laundry cart. You're the getaway driver because you still have a license.
text.zh: 養老院的住戶策劃用洗衣推車越獄。因為你還有駕照，所以你負責開車接應。

text.en: Escape. Freedom tastes like fast food.
text.zh: 越獄。自由的味道像速食。

text.en: Stay and demand extra pudding.
text.zh: 留下來，並要求加碼布丁。

text.en: A group of teens challenges you to a dance-off. You bring your walker and 60 years of unresolved moves.
text.zh: 一群青少年向你下戰帖，要辦舞蹈對決。你帶著助行器，和六十年來還沒用完的舞步。

text.en: Dance. Let the walker do the spinning.
text.zh: 跳。讓助行器負責旋轉。

text.en: Watch and clap. Save your hips for later.
text.zh: 在旁邊鼓掌。把髖關節留給以後。

text.en: A company offers to press your ashes into a vinyl record. You need to record a track first. Your snoring is 'authentic'.
text.zh: 有間公司可以把你的骨灰做成黑膠唱片。你得先錄一首歌。而你的打呼聲『很有原創性』。

text.en: Do it. Your snores go platinum posthumously.
text.zh: 做。你的鼾聲身後成為白金唱片。

text.en: Choose a standard urn. Boring but silent.
text.zh: 選標準骨灰罈。無聊但安靜。

text.en: Without your glasses, you sign a donation form. It turns out you gave your entire estate to the Stray Cat Sanctuary.
text.zh: 沒戴老花眼鏡的你簽了一份捐贈表格。結果你把整份遺產都捐給了流浪貓收容所。

text.en: Keep it. The cats send you a thank-you card.
text.zh: 認了。貓咪們寄來一張感謝卡。

text.en: Hire a lawyer to void it. Face the cats' lawyer.
text.zh: 請律師撤銷。然後面對貓咪們的律師。

text.en: A company offers to freeze your body 'until medicine improves'. The brochure features a smiling penguin.
text.zh: 一間公司提供人體冷凍服務，承諾『等醫學進步再叫醒你』。宣傳單上有一隻微笑的企鵝。

text.en: Sign for $150,000 and one very long nap.
text.zh: 簽約，十五萬美金換一場非常長的午覺。

text.en: Refuse. Die like a normal person.
text.zh: 拒絕。像正常人一樣去世。

text.en: A 28-year-old influencer says she loves your 'wisdom and vintage energy'. Her camera crew is already in your living room.
text.zh: 一位 28 歲的網紅說她愛你的『智慧與復古氣質』。她的攝影團隊已經在你客廳就位了。

text.en: Marry her. Let the content flow.
text.zh: 娶她。讓流量滾滾而來。

text.en: Refuse. Keep your dignity and your wallet.
text.zh: 拒絕。保住尊嚴和錢包。

text.en: You no longer trust banks, crypto, or nephews. You want to convert your life savings into gold bars and bury them in the garden.
text.zh: 你不再相信銀行、加密貨幣，也不信任侄子。你想把畢生積蓄換成金條，埋在花園裡。

text.en: Bury the gold. Draw a treasure map 'just in case'.
text.zh: 把金條埋起來。『以防萬一』畫一張藏寶圖。

text.en: Put it in index funds like a boring adult.
text.zh: 像個無聊的大人一樣放進指數基金。

text.en: A publisher offers a fortune for your unfiltered memoir, including everything you never told your family. Your family will read it first.
text.zh: 出版社開高價買你毫無保留的回憶錄，包括所有你從沒告訴家人的事。而你的家人會是第一批讀者。

text.en: Publish everything. Let the truth have its book tour.
text.zh: 全部出版。讓真相開簽書會。

text.en: Burn the manuscript. Some secrets keep the peace.
text.zh: 把手稿燒掉。有些秘密能維持和平。

text.en: While walking in the nursing-home garden, you see a line of green binary code drift across the sky and vanish.
text.zh: 在安養院花園散步時，你看見一行綠色的二進制代碼飄過天空，然後消失。

text.en: Tell the nurse. She adjusts your medication.
text.zh: 告訴護士。她調整了你的藥量。

text.en: Take notes and photos. Science begins at 80.
text.zh: 拍照做筆記。科學從八十歲開始。

text.en: The janitor mopping your hallway stops and whispers: 'Cosmic Backstage Admin. Sorry, your save file has a memory leak.'
text.zh: 在走廊拖地的清潔工突然停下來低語：「我是宇宙後台管理員。抱歉，你的存檔有記憶體洩漏。」

text.en: Demand a complete list of every bug in your life.
text.zh: 要求他列出你人生中所有的漏洞清單。

text.en: Demand compensation for eighty years of bad patches.
text.zh: 要求為八十年的爛更新補償。

text.en: The admin offers a deal: $1,000,000 hush money to quietly live until 100, or press the red button on your watch to glimpse 'reality'.
text.zh: 管理員提出交易：一百萬封口費，讓你安靜活到一百歲；或者按下手錶上的紅色按鈕，看一眼『現實』。

text.en: Take the money and the bug fix. Live quietly.
text.zh: 收下錢和漏洞修復。安靜地活著。

text.en: Press the red button. Take a look outside the simulation.
text.zh: 按下紅色按鈕。看一眼模擬世界之外。

text.en: Final choice: accept the code and become creator of the virtual world, or yank the plug and wake up in a real hospital bed.
text.zh: 終極抉擇：接受代碼，成為虛擬世界的造物主；或者強行拔線，在真實世界的病床上醒來。

text.en: Accept the code. Become the creator. Edit the pudding menu.
text.zh: 接受代碼。成為造物主。順便改一下布丁菜單。

text.en: Yank the plug. Wake up in Room 404, real and complicated.
text.zh: 強行拔線。在 404 病房醒來，真實而複雜。

text.en: Your retirement party has a sheet cake reading 'Congrats On Escaping!' Your boss whispers: 'Any chance you'd consult for us? Part-time. Full-time hours.'
text.zh: 你的退休派對蛋糕上寫著『恭喜脫逃成功！』老闆悄悄問：『你有沒有可能當我們的顧問？兼職，但全職時數。』

text.en: Say yes. Retirement is just a rumor.
text.zh: 答應。退休只是個傳聞。

setJob.zh: 顧問（兼職名義，全職時數）

text.en: Take the cake home and never check your work inbox again.
text.zh: 把蛋糕打包回家，再也不看工作信箱。

text.en: HR proposes a 'phased retirement': half the pay, all the meetings, and a mentoring role for a 24-year-old who has never lost a spreadsheet.
text.zh: 人資提出『漸進式退休』：薪水砍半、會議全留，外加輔導一位從沒丟過試算表的 24 歲新人。

text.en: Accept. Half a salary buys a lot of dignity.
text.zh: 接受。半份薪水，換一整份尊嚴。

text.en: Take the lump-sum package and leave on a Friday. Silence every notification.
text.zh: 領走一次性補償，週五就走人。關掉所有通知。

text.en: Your grown kids have scheduled your babysitting shifts: three days a week. You never applied for this job.
text.zh: 你的孩子們已經幫你排好了帶孫班表：每週三天。你根本沒應徵過這份工作。

text.en: Accept the shifts. Learn the plot of a cartoon about talking trucks.
text.zh: 接受排班。認真研讀一部會說話卡車的卡通劇情。

text.en: Negotiate down to one day a week. Endure the guilt trip with extra sighs.
text.zh: 談判到每週一天。承受附贈嘆氣的愧疚攻勢。

text.en: You want a camper van to 'find yourself' on the open road. Your back wants a memory-foam mattress and a private bathroom.
text.zh: 你想買一台露營車上路『尋找自我』。你的腰只想要記憶棉床墊和專屬廁所。

text.en: Buy the van. Name it 'Freedom'. Its bathroom is the size of a shoebox.
text.zh: 買下露營車，取名『自由號』。它的廁所只有鞋盒那麼大。

text.en: Book a comfy hotel road trip instead. Adventure with room service.
text.zh: 改訂舒適的飯店公路之旅。附送客房服務的冒險。

text.en: Your camper van dies in a desert town with one diner and forty retired mechanics, all of whom have opinions.
text.zh: 你的露營車在一個只有一間小餐館的沙漠小鎮拋錨，鎮上有四十位退休技師，每個人都有意見。

text.en: Let them fix it. Pay in pie and travel stories.
text.zh: 讓他們修。用派和旅行故事付帳。

text.en: Call a tow truck and sulk at the counter.
text.zh: 叫拖吊車，然後在櫃檯邊生悶氣。
